NLocalArithmetic.both_tests_localExpression_eq_semilocal.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [(w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) → MeasurableSpace w.Completionˣ]
  [(v : NumberField.FinitePlace K) →
      MeasurableSpace (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ]
  (muInf : (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) → MeasureTheory.Measure w.Completionˣ)
  (muFin :
    (v : NumberField.FinitePlace K) →
      MeasureTheory.Measure (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) :
  ∃ S,
    ∀ (q : Fin 2),
      NLocalArithmetic.localExpression K muInf muFin (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) =
        NLocalArithmetic.semilocalExpression K muInf muFin S (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)
